paper: A Profitable Day Trading Strategy For The U.S. Equity Market

paper_rules.relative_volume: opening-range volume divided by prior 14-session average
paper_rules.exit: stop loss or end of regular session

adaptations: MT5 provides tick-volume proxy rather than consolidated share volume.
The paper's 1,000,000-share daily-volume filter is disabled because tick volume is not shares.
Spread and round-trip per-unit commission are included.
